name: flowboard
description: FlowBoard — A modern team task manager with Kanban boards, role-based access control, and real-time activity tracking

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node src/index.js
scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
